This is a list of '''mayors''' and chairmen of the [[City of Fitzroy]], a former [[Local Government Areas of Victoria|local government area]] in  [[Melbourne]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]], [[Australia]] and its precedents. It existed from 1858 until 1994 when it merged with the [[City of Collingwood]] and [[City of Richmond]] to form the new [[City of Yarra]].
